semiconductor_relevance: High — Gillion Application Technology Co., Ltd specializes in electronic-grade functional tapes and customized equipment for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Gillion Application Technology Co., Ltd is a leading manufacturer of electronic-grade functional tapes and customized automation equipment, serving the semiconductor and related industries. With a focus on R&D, production, and sales, the company offers integrated solutions that cater to various applications in semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, with major production bases in Renwu and Gangshan.
